narrative: Markets are rallying as election uncertainty dissipates following a Democratic sweep, which is expected to result in government gridlock and policy restraint. While the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 have moved higher, the technology sector is facing internal pressure from disappointing semiconductor guidance and concerns over AI revenue sustainability. Treasury yields and the USD are trending lower as investors digest the fiscal implications of the election outcome. Meanwhile, the energy sector has seen a sharp decline driven by demand concerns and geopolitical optimism regarding US-Iran relations.

Nasdaq.why: Anchors note the index is rallying as election uncertainty eases, though gains are tempered by disappointing guidance from Qualcomm and Arm and broader AI sustainability concerns.

S&P 500.why: The index is rallying on the removal of election uncertainty, with the equal-weighted version reaching an all-time high according to anchors.

Gold.why: Anchors report gold is trading higher as the market reacts to the conclusion of the election cycle.

Oil.why: Prices dropped approximately 8% due to demand concerns and optimism for US-Iran peace, as noted by anchors.

priced_in: A more muted election reaction than in previous cycles
Expectations for potential rate hikes in December
A more restrictive regulatory environment and potential moratorium on data center construction
debates: Sustainability of AI-related revenue growth versus current investor expectations
Whether a Democratic sweep will lead to policy restraint via gridlock or a more restrictive regulatory environment
The impact of disappointing semiconductor guidance on the broader tech sector rally
